evidence.name: Screen field: Supporting line look
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Supporting line look" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Supporting line look
sections.description: Open this to override the supporting line's font size, weight, color, alignment, and the padding around it; it shows only when the template includes a subtitle. Keep this line visually lighter than the headline (smaller or thinner) so the slide reads in the right order. Leave it on theme defaults for consistency unless this carousel needs a custom look, and remember changes apply to every slide.
